summary.result: The results of this study propose three methods to estimate the monetary costs and carbon benefits by adopting the framework for the economic evaluation of national R&D projects conducted by the Rural Development Administration.
summary.background: Carbon neutrality is emerging as a new paradigm for the international society by transiting from climate change to climate risk.
summary.method: Finally, the proposed methods were tested and verified for the efficiency and validity of evaluating carbon reduction contribution.
